notes.title: FLTG 0.9.12A
notes.notes:
Finally! The game is released!

Now last version is 0.9.12A.
Well, this version have many bug fixes after 0.9.1A, so you can play normally.

Achivments was finished!
Game balance is on hardcore level!

You can offer other ideas in discussions, some of them I will think over on the course of development.

Thank you! Enjoy!

P.S. Work on the game is progressing slowly because I got a lot of work. I can’t say when the new update will be released! Sincerely, Andrey Bondarenko.

notes.title: FLTG 0.9.1A
notes.notes:
Finally! The working version was finished!

The game version is 0.9.1A, why? 
Well, this version is just working, but it lacks some things (Nothing serious): [list]
[*] Achievements and some functions will be improved.
[*] I planned to add mods (Workshop integration).
[*] I want to balance some systems.
[/list]

You can offer other ideas in discussions, some of them I will think over on the course of development.

Thank you! Enjoy!
